description: This file defines data structures, an enum, and a class related to monitoring and representing the health status of a service or system component within an app. It includes models for health snapshots, logic to check health status, and a singleton store (`HealthStore`) responsible for fetching and maintaining this data, supporting periodic refreshes and error handling.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages health data fetching, storage, and status assessment, utilizing background tasks and providing information such as the current health state and status lines.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to manually set the health snapshot and last error for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background health polling task unless already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the background health polling task.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand refresh of the health snapshot data from the control channel.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a given channel summary indicates a healthy channel.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a failed health probe.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Identifies the linked channel from the health snapshot, prioritizing linked channels.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds a fallback healthy channel, excluding a specified ID.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of a failure based on the snapshot and fallback info.
